model.architecture: Fully-hybrid decoder (FalconH1ForCausalLM, 44L, hidden 1024, GQA 8:2): every layer runs grouped-query attention and a Mamba2 selective-scan branch in parallel and sums them, so each layer carries KV plus constant-size conv/SSM state (176 state buffers). Reasoning model: self-emits <think>...</think> before answering; thought channel declared in bundle metadata

session_defaults.notes: Reasoning model: give it a generous output budget (>=2048) or set a thinking budget - truncated mid-thought it produces no final answer. Multi-turn fact recall is weak at this size (the bf16 model fails the same recall probes); treat it as a single-turn reasoner.

variants.quantization: int8 dynamic on FC only; embedding table externalized to its own CPU-side section and kept FLOAT (int8 embedding, even per-row, measurably destabilizes this checkpoint's reasoning); convs and the scan stay float; fp32 activations declared for GPU

recommended.reason: verified by generation (8Q 7/8); 2216 tok/s prefill / 97.8 tok/s decode / TTFT 0.13 s - GPU wins both directions on M4 Max

verified by generation on iPhone 17 Pro (8Q 6/8 both backends, identical answers): CPU decodes FASTER than Metal at this size (29.4 vs 22.8 tok/s) at a quarter of the peak memory (0.82 vs 3.0 GB); the Metal engine works but pays setup overhead a 0.6B never amortizes

measured on one Galaxy S26 with one binary (S7 Android backfill 2026-09-05, 205-token prompt, 2 cold runs per backend, cooled before each run): cpu decodes 22.63-23.9 tok/s against gpu's 15.26-16.13 (1.5x), prefill 124.0-218.2 vs 309.8-318.7 tok/s, peak 1716 vs 3233 MB, engine init 4.4 vs 48.3 s. Same-device GPU control taken - a measured win for cpu on decode. A reasoning model decodes for thousands of tokens before it answers, so decode speed dominates. Answer verified through the thought channel on both backends

measured on one Pixel 8a with one binary (S7 Android backfill 2026-09-05, 205-token prompt, 2 cold runs per backend, cooled before each run): cpu decodes 13.74-14.02 tok/s against gpu's 9.97 (1.4x), prefill 39.8-71.2 vs 109.0 tok/s, peak 1710 vs 4914 MB, engine init 7.0 vs 59.1 s. Same-device GPU control taken - a measured win for cpu on decode. A reasoning model decodes for thousands of tokens before it answers (1382-2313 here), so decode speed dominates; the GPU also needs a 59-68 s engine init and peaks at 4.7-4.9 GB on this 8 GB phone against 1.7 GB on the CPU. Answer verified through the thought channel on both backends. Same direction as the flagship recommendation on the Galaxy S26 (cpu 1.5x)
